scene_context_seed.location_name: Junction-area camp with optional Southern Briar backtrack
scene_context_seed.runtime_note: CAMP PRESENTATION: Cyanis, Ilyra, Torren, and Maevra may all be present as field models around camp; Cyanis-only wilderness traversal does not apply inside the camp hub. Portraits/dialogue carry most character performance. C03/C04/C05 are existing approved Character-Life dialogue authorities and should not be casually rewritten; relocate/presentation-normalize their staging only. C04 is Torren working on ordinary modern route maps, not a second ancient-map reveal. OPTIONAL BACKTRACK: when the player leaves camp for Southern Briar, Cyanis-only ordinary traversal resumes and the Cistern Devourer entrance is the earlier overgrown Briar-side access, not the Junction. No second dialogue explanation is needed. REST: optional content may be skipped; choosing rest advances to morning. MORNING: short departure scene at camp, then Cyanis-only route traversal resumes toward Dunmere. HARD FIREWALL: no Prime, Last Sentinel, bearer, Entity, or complete ancient-network answers.

required_story_beats: Junction-area camp functions as the safe Chapter-1 cleanup hub.
Party members may be visible as field models around camp.
C03, C04, and C05 are optional and do not advance the chapter independently.
The player may backtrack into Southern Briar and use the earlier overgrown side access for the optional Cistern Devourer Hunt.
Choosing rest closes the cleanup window and advances to the next morning.
The party departs toward already-planned Dunmere.
Ordinary wilderness traversal after departure returns to Cyanis-only field presentation.
Chapter 1 ends on departure from the Junction camp area.
